# SpinWheelPlus Embed (official)

> Official embed documentation for SpinWheelPlus spin wheels and mystery boxes on third-party websites. Embed v1: script loader plus isolated iframe.

## Canonical URLs

- Product: https://spinwheelplus.com
- This documentation repo: https://github.com/spinwheelplus-lgtm/spinwheelplus-embed
- Loader script: https://spinwheelplus.com/embed/v1/loader.js

## Embed surfaces

- Spin wheel iframe: https://spinwheelplus.com/embed/{slug}
- Mystery box iframe: https://spinwheelplus.com/mystery-box/{slug}/embed

## Loader (host page)

- Use `data-wheel="{slug}"` for spin wheels OR `data-box="{slug}"` for mystery boxes (one per script tag).
- Modes: `data-mode="inline"` (fixed box) or `data-mode="sidebar"` (edge panel).
- Optional host badge: `data-logo="on"` adds a “Powered by SpinWheelPlus” link on the parent page.

## Requirements

- Publisher must enable Allow embed on the wheel or mystery box.
- Host sites with strict CSP must allow the SpinWheelPlus origin in `script-src` and `frame-src`.

## Live examples (documentation)

- Spin wheel: https://spinwheelplus.com/wheel/birthday-my-store-wks8vf (embed slug `birthday-my-store-wks8vf`)
- Mystery box: https://spinwheelplus.com/mystery-box/bookstore-birthday-8aj3sj (embed slug `bookstore-birthday-8aj3sj`)

## Audience

Teachers, students, marketing, landing pages, team games, small events — English docs. Default: share a link on spinwheelplus.com. Embed when the widget should live on your own site. Guest forms and logs are up to the creator’s settings.

## Feedback

spinwheelplus@gmail.com

## Spin result events (wheels only, v1)

Message type: `spinwheelplus:result` — sent from wheel iframe to parent after each completed spin. Mystery box embed does not emit this event in v1.
